description: Monitor cloudflared tunnel health via systemd, Prometheus metrics, and ready endpoint

requirements.title: Systemd service status check
requirements.description: Check cloudflared systemd service status via 'systemctl is-active cloudflared'. Report active/inactive/failed states.

requirements.title: Ready endpoint check
requirements.description: Poll cloudflared's /ready endpoint (configurable host:port, default 127.0.0.1:20241). Returns 200 when tunnel has established connections and is ready to serve traffic.

requirements.title: Prometheus metrics scraping
requirements.description: Scrape cloudflared's /metrics endpoint for key gauges: cloudflared_tunnel_ha_connections, cloudflared_tunnel_request_errors, cloudflared_tunnel_active_streams, quic_client_smoothed_rtt

requirements.title: HA connection monitoring
requirements.description: Track cloudflared_tunnel_ha_connections gauge. Normal is 4. If < 4, report degraded. If 0, report critical.

requirements.title: Error rate tracking
requirements.description: Track cloudflared_tunnel_request_errors counter. Calculate rate over 5-minute windows. Alert if error rate exceeds configurable threshold.

requirements.title: Composite health score
requirements.description: Calculate overall tunnel health as: healthy (systemd active + ready 200 + HA >= 4), degraded (systemd active + any sub-check warning), critical (systemd inactive or ready non-200)
